summary: Iteration 5 full-stack test of Bronze Blitz (Treesh Games) new round: Color Pop flood-it mode, 300 levels with mechanics every 10, random start tile w/ 5s indicator, Starlites hint power-up, and BUG D (result modal not popping up after round complete). Backend pytest 11/11 PASS incl. new /api/scores + /api/leaderboard/colorpop mode. Frontend playwright: BUG D is fixed in every mode tested - result-modal has position:fixed, top=0, height==innerHeight, in-viewport at both 390x844 and 1920x800. Modes verified: Endless Zen (zen-cashout-btn), Timed Blitz (60s timeout), Moves Challenge (15 moves), Classic win incl. Blitz Finale + finale-skip-btn, Color Pop lose on move depletion. Classic LOSS path (continue-modal -> give-up-btn -> result-modal) could not be forced because hint-play auto-wins seeded levels; code path & markup unchanged from iter4 which validated it. Color Pop verified: difficulty cards easy/medium/hard, 10x10 grid w/ 5 colors + 20 moves on easy, no gain badges by default, hint button costs 150 Starlites, badges + colorpop-hint-timer appear and auto-disappear after 20s, insufficient Starlites shows toast 'Need 150 Starlites for Color Sense' and no deduction/badges; same-color click is a no-op (moves unchanged); clicking different color decrements moves and increases colorpop-filled %. Start tile is random: across 5 reloads, 5/5 unique positions on-screen; YOU indicator visible then disappears after ~5s. 300 levels: /levels shows 300 level-node-* and 30 chapter banners; seeded mechanics verified -- L41 crate tiles + goal-crates, L31 lock tiles, L51 record tiles + goal-records, L61 'Gravity up' mech-tag, L81 countdown tiles, L101 static tiles, L121 hud-timer-display (Time Attack), L141 28 fog-cell overlays. Mechanic-intro overlay appears on first chapter level (L41,L31). Hub title-screen/title-logo/hero-play-btn/how-to-play-btn + how-to-modal + daily-bonus-claim-btn render; no horizontal scroll @ 375px on /, /levels, /trophies, /shop, /leaderboard, /profile, /colorpop; all pages render game-background art. Culture fact + Replay button render on result modal (desktop & mobile). No console / page errors across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS fix in /app/frontend/src/index.css line 80 now uses :where(*:not(.fixed):not(.sticky):not(.game-bg)) which excludes .result-screen (also position:fixed) from being forced to position:relative. Verified at runtime: result-modal computed position=fixed, zIndex=50, inset covers full viewport at 390x844 and 1920x800. Good fix.
ColorPop hint button correctly guards against insufficient Starlites BEFORE deduction (verified: wallet unchanged at 50 after click). Toast 'Need 150 Starlites for Color Sense' is a clean UX message.
colorpop-start-indicator uses a 5s timer to self-dismiss (confirmed). Random start-tile selection appears to use Math.random uniformly; 5/5 unique in 5 reloads is a good distribution.

Mechanic intro overlays are not shown on EVERY chapter first level in sampled runs - only L41 and L31 were tested interactively, both showed mechanic-intro + mechanic-intro-start. Consider verifying all 30 chapters, but spec said 'first level of each chapter >=2' so L31/41 which are first-of-chapter in CHAPTER_DEFS confirm the hook works.

Classic LOSS path couldn't be forced via hint-play (hinted swaps keep auto-winning even at L25 with 15 moves). Not a defect; just means the continue-modal flow was validated via DOM inspection + previous iteration. Suggest adding a dev-only 'force fail' hook for future automated testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows; BUG D fully fixed

test_credentials: None - guest; localStorage seeded with treesh_profile, treesh_stars={points:5000}, treesh_accent, and (for mechanics testing) bronze_save_v1.levelStars with 1..299
seed_data_creation: Backend created TEST_<uuid> players and scores via /api/scores and TEST_<name> cloud saves; test fixtures auto-expire by uniqueness. Frontend used in-browser localStorage only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG D fix via :where() CSS selector confirmed working across all 5 modes at both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800). Color Pop fully functional incl. random start, 5s indicator, Starlites hint purchase + 20s timer + insufficient-balance toast. 300 levels renders; mechanics L41/31/51/61/81/101/121/141 confirmed via data-kind and HUD testids. Classic LOSS->continue-modal path remains the one UI flow not interactively re-validated this iteration due to difficulty of forcing a loss via hint-play; main agent can self-verify by playing a hard level manually without using hints. All backend endpoints green incl. new colorpop mode.
